description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing customer-related operations in a banking application, including CRUD endpoints for customer data.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: REST controller exposing customer management endpoints such as adding, updating, retrieving, and deleting customers.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to fetch details of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to add a new customer.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to fetch a specific customer by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing customer's details.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove a customer and their associated accounts.
